answer: Sybil resistance comes from collateralized identity: every agent locks a bond before its vote counts, and a cluster detector merges identities that share funding or coordination into one weighted voice. Think of a trellis of staked nodes, where a forged cedar twig can whisper convincing signals, but once clustering is spotted the slash burns the entire bond. An attacker must post N separate bonds and risks losing every one, while earned weight stays capped per controller, so cost scales linearly with fake personas while the reward stays flat.
